2. A craft tree is never re-rooted by a merge. src/sim/vessel/public.ts keeps its signatures.
3. State is whole: friction anchors, thermal wake factors, wet flags and probe contact flags leave Vessel.struct and become vessel state (cloneVessel copies them). src/sim/vessel/codec.ts: binary, exact, definitions by id, non-finite numbers tagged, sign of zero preserved; encodeVessel/decodeVessel and a cheap copy for rollback rings. stateHash hashes codec output.

5. The sweep, compiler-driven, one commit per subsystem: SimSnapshot.tick -> revision; activeVesselId nullable with neutral singleton blocks (neutralFlightBlocks()); part keys; cockpit interior, seat and engine clusters from the command part and the part list instead of defs.vehicles[vehicleId]; Readouts.target replaces targetBodyId/targetClosestApproach; the pause action becomes flightMenu; src/core/math/frame.ts with rebase helpers, applied by the render core's previous-frame state, the camera rigs, the map focus and world-anchored effects.

SCOPE A - island (src/sim/island): N vessels on one clock's tick grid, ordered by vessel id. The per-vessel state machine (landed, rails, armed, integrated), exact rails advance to events, SOI hand-over as a unit at the anchor's tick, the reduced tier and terrain policy move here from World unchanged in numerics. The step loop advances the whole island sub-step by sub-step (480 Hz) calling the existing per-vessel force evaluation, with a hook for a pair pass (empty this wave: contact-docking fills it). Reference orbit and the optional Encke origin in VesselEnvironment for the Sun's SOI (Battin f(q)). Armed tier (ARCHITECTURE 6.2). Step modes authoritative and predict (threshold transitions suppressed, a part held at its limit). Structural operations (split, destroy, add, remove, rebase, replace) as data with a result checksum, applied identically by anyone who holds the island state. Threshold-watch flag.
SCOPE B - view (src/sim/view): pure builders from island state plus planning state: SimSnapshot with presentation interpolation, frame and rebase, readouts, navball, staging info per craft, patches and markers, nodes and burn bookkeeping, surface targets from every site, TimeView. Planning commands are local to the view.
SCOPE C - universe (src/universe; pure, time and storage injected through universe.ts): directory records and worldlines; clocks as closed-form schedules with untilTick; rules U1-U19 and the pad rules exactly as written, every number read from UniverseRules; solid window, admission and claim commit (the commit path exists; first-touch detection needs contact and is finished by contact-docking), materialisation; screening of rails trajectories against the solid predicate over an interval with re-screen on commit (src/sim/orbit/conjunction: shell filter, minimum distance between conics, closest approach in time, in-phase jump search); island lifecycle (materialise at a grid tick, merge, split, to rails, migrate by value) with holder and epoch; lanes with lagCap, tau and the acceptance window (scheduler interface: the caller says how much wall time it has; real-time and trailing batches produce identical state); unattended runs paced by clock kind; pad timetable with cohort and window slots; expiry sweep; objectives observer (milestones.ts moved); admission hooks. UniverseHost emits the typed messages of net.ts (keys exact, deltas, ops, census, clock, conjunctions, events).
SCOPE D - LocalSession (src/client/local): FlightSession over an in-process universe, authoritative state presented directly, plus ready, terrainPending, step, advanceRails, stateHash, debug. createSim(defs, scenarioId, { terrain }) returns it: the scenario fixes the local epoch, spawns on the pad, attaches objectives. Pilots, labs, tests/browser/integration and the mission run on it. Then delete src/sim/world and the Sim alias.
